verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies. The evidence covers a REST API, webhooks, Action Plans and rule-based automations, but nothing documents an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Rule-based automation is an adjacent feature, not an AI assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
